liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments rose by {{cash_like.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_like@FY2025}}, and total liquidity stood at {{liquidity@FY2025}}, including {{undrawn_facilities@FY2025}} of undrawn committed facilities.
